## The idea

What should VectorZip be able to do that it can't today?

## Why it matters

Who benefits, and in what situation? (e.g. "compressing log archives faster",
"a headless mode for scripts").

## How it could work

Sketch the behavior: new CLI flag, GUI control, library function, format
change — whatever fits. Backward compatibility matters here: the `.vzip`
format must stay readable for older archives unless there's a very good
reason.

## Alternatives

Anything else you tried, or ways you've worked around this already.
